notes: Borrowed from the Ioniq 5 77.4 kWh electrive 2023 test (see that curve). Not measured on an Ioniq 6; its taper may differ because of different thermal management.

based_on.reason: Same E-GMP 77.4 kWh (74 usable) 800 V NMC pack and 233 kW DC peak (estimated, EV Database) as the 2023 Ioniq 5 Long Range; the Ioniq 6 shares the charging hardware. No Ioniq 6 measured curve with usable numbers was found. IONIQ 6 pack and DC peak figures are estimates, so the match is unproven.
